latestReleaseGate.evidenceBoundary: The accepted mainline source and hosted-CI baseline remains GitHub Actions run 30471584219: 241 automated tests, 78 Convex-focused tests, production build, and all 39 active Chromium journeys passed without retry or flaky annotation, with one unrelated background-visibility case explicitly skipped. The protected-preview provider delta is separately evidenced by provider composition commit 8259137 and startup-order correction f8bdb75; focused transport tests passed 25/25 and lint, typecheck, production build, and git diff validation passed locally. Vercel deployment dpl_CX6vYyHL231FSEWuQZvtQJmBVWW5 built READY from exact commit f8bdb75b4f0cba3b0dae6834ff67cda8733fb1fb and received stable alias https://realworld-cloud-preview-mosnins-projects.vercel.app. Convex development deployment hallowed-snail-690 issued a valid Ably TokenRequest using encrypted preview-only settings. Live provider evidence showed two simultaneous TLS WebSocket clients on SDK 2.26.0 with distinct pseudonymous identities and exact authorized room capabilities: owner in Mission Core and scoped reviewer only in Workshop, without history capability. Client teardown reduced the provider connection count to zero, and reopening established a new connection id before the final two-session concurrent check. Production was not connected or changed. This proves development token issuance, provider authentication, exact room capability isolation, disconnect cleanup, and reconnect on the protected preview. It does not prove participant-facing presence truth, cursor or selection UI, forced revocation of an already-issued token, simultaneous durable cloud edits, background recovery, load, agent runtime, or production readiness.
